notes:
Proxy errors now name the real cause.

A proxy answering "407" was reported as needing a username and password. On most providers it means this PC's IP is not on their allowed list - a different fix, in a different place. Both are named now, and OPTiC's own proxy test tells you which, because it connects from your machine rather than from the provider's.

Also in this release: the Settings page no longer overwrites fields while you are typing in them, a failed save no longer reports success, a city panel could show another city's walls, incoming-attack alerts survive a Discord hiccup, dismissing one food alert no longer silences it for a year, and Ctrl+K now finds any setting by name.

Nothing you need to do after updating.
